name: cairn
description: Spec-driven development on beads: interview, spec, tickets and implementation, with optional tracker sync.

interface.longDescription: Keep specs and tickets on bd. Interview with cairn grill, implement an existing spec with cairn implement, and inspect the board with cairn status. Optional spokes mirror the beads graph.
defaultPrompt: Use $cairn:grill to refine this idea into a spec.
Use $cairn:implement to work on an existing spec.
Use $cairn:status to show the project board.
